name: Noob Onslaught Classic
desc:
This is now the legacy/classic version of Noob Onslaught. This remains here because Version 3 required save file resets. So, your old save file is here, along with the old version of the game. The only time this will get updated is if a Roblox update ever breaks it.

Welcome to Noob Onslaught! Do you have what it takes to defend your castle from hoards of incoming noobs? Unlock awesome weapons, fight awesome enemies, upgrade tons of stats, and survive as long as possible!

Join the group below to leave feedback or suggestions on the game, and get a free weapon!

Current Server Version: 2.3.0


Please leave a like if you enjoyed!

[Credit to thunder1222 and Cadthrenal]
